Before you hire

  1. What is the collection schedule and overflow policy?
  2. Are bulky items and post-renovation debris priced separately?
  3. Can the property support bear-resistant or other appropriate storage?

Ask for a written scope, itemized pricing, recent relevant references and confirmation that the vendor serves your exact address.
